Example: - Project [c:\project\project.proj] - Data [c:\some_other_folder\data] - Folder [c:\some_other_folder\data\folder] - File1 [c:\some_other_folder\data\file1] - File2 [c:\some_other_folder\data\file2] In that case we want to get rid of it and move files one level higher (especially in UE4).
